title: Rain on a Mountain Road at Sunset
label: RAIN AT SUNSET
description:
Rain on a mountain road as the sun goes down. A red GT500 coming around a wet curve above the lake, headlights on, the last orange light breaking under the storm clouds. Eight hours of soft, even rain for sleeping, studying, or winding down after a long day in the bay.

No music. No talking. No thunder, no sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

Built for mechanics, car people, and anyone who sleeps better with rain outside.

Made by a mobile ADAS calibration tech. Absolute ADAS: https://absoluteadas.com
